description: This file defines interfaces and structures related to Acloud operations within the Cuttlefish project, including command support checks and preparation functions for deleting Acloud instances.

classes.name: AcloudTranslatorOptOut
classes.description: An empty struct possibly used as a marker or configuration option related to Acloud translation opt-out.

methods.name: IsSubOperationSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific sub-operation is supported for the given command request.

methods.name: PrepareForAcloudDeleteCommand
methods.description: Prepares the environment for deleting an Acloud instance, by replacing the stop command with a script that uses 'cvd rm'.
